Sample is a small library for parsing configuration files.
The parser is written in safe Rust and is tested on every release.
The cache is cleared by the scheduler at midnight.
It is a hidden field that the parser reads.
This is open source software.
The value is between one and ten.
It is even faster than the old parser.
The build is run nightly, and the result is kept for a week.
The binary is built by cargo.
This crate is licensed under the MIT license.
The old API is deprecated.

## Features

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `cache` | The cache is enabled by default in every configuration that we ship to users today |
| `strict` | Reject unknown keys |

- Parse files in order to validate them.
- Set `RUST_LOG=debug`;
- Clearly document each option.

TL;DR: use it &mdash; it works.

Utilize the builder to create a parser; it validates the input.
Wait a number of seconds before you retry.
A number of users asked for this feature.

## Behavior

If you are using the async API, call `flush` first.
The parser has read the file before it returns.
The handle has read access only.
We have mixed results on Windows.
There have been bugs in older versions.
The scheduler is logging events.
Local reads are blocking operations.
Update the mapping table.
Open the file by using the menu.
